title: Paper-to-rule register for the integrated inquiry architecture
scope: Sixteen bounded declarations, conditional rules and hypotheses extracted from actual local programme texts; no implementation or empirical validation is asserted.
citation_convention: One-based raw text-file line numbers, including extracted page markers; source SHA-256 binds the cited snapshot.

rule_kind_definitions.formal_conditional: A mathematical implication under listed premises; classification is not a certificate that an instance satisfies them.
rule_kind_definitions.model_assumption: An explicitly declared representation or mechanism; not inferred as a fact merely by registering it.
rule_kind_definitions.empirical_hypothesis: An outcome claim needing prospective or held-out evidence; may emit only scoped test status.
rule_kind_definitions.analogy: A question-generating correspondence; no automatic entailment or empirical support transfer.

execution_policy.on_false_required_premise: out_of_scope for this theorem application; do not label the theorem refuted
execution_policy.on_valid_counterexample: counterexample only to the precisely instantiated claim under verified premises
execution_policy.on_empty_model_family: report inconsistent premises/model family; prohibit substantive vacuous entailment
execution_policy.on_source_hash_change: mark citations stale and re-read before re-admission
execution_policy.numeric_contract: Exact identities prefer rational/symbolic arithmetic. Approximate solvers must expose tolerance, error bounds, domain coverage and unknown regions.
execution_policy.dependency_contract: Retain premise, source, model, data and solver-version dependencies in every emitted result.
execution_policy.domain_transfer_contract: Biological, physical, AI and arithmetic instances require their own mechanism and observation contracts.

sources.title: Epistemic Type Safety for Generative AI
The Temporal Architecture of Living Nature
From Predictive State to Viable Action
Two failure modes of glutathione homeostasis

rules.title: Declare the observer, unit and question before inference

premises.statement: Declare boundary/interface, persistence or identity criterion, and horizon independently of the response pattern later evaluated.
Declare admitted histories, interventions, observations, timing, operating range, discrepancy margins and observer access.
Bind the declaration to one version; indicate which quantities are internal, environmental or coupled.

conclusion_schema.meaning: Subsequent state, action and constraint claims are interpreted only within this declaration.

solver_requirements.soundness_requirement: Check completeness and internal compatibility; prospective timing needs provenance, not a self-reported Boolean.

does_not_follow: A declared boundary is the unique natural system boundary.
The declared measurements already form a sufficient state.
All sciences share one physical state carrier or one mechanism.
rules.revision_context: Current-05 separates prospective unit declaration from state inference. Current-07 treats the observer as a physical subsystem, without observer-created reality.

rules.title: Exact predictive quotient

premises.statement: Fix a coherent family of future intervention/observation laws on the same admitted history class.
Define equivalence by equality of every declared future law, including agreement of future admissibility.
Use exact equality. For continuous records, supply the measurable/common-support and common-null-set qualifications in section 2.1.

conclusion_schema.formula: h ~ h_prime iff for every u in Pi, Law(Y | h,u) = Law(Y | h_prime,u), including admissibility
conclusion_schema.consequence: S_Pi = H / ~ is the coarsest exact sufficient partition; any exact sufficient code z can merge only histories merged by S_Pi.

required_inputs: finite complete family or proof of all-family equality
solver_requirements.soundness_requirement: A finite sampled future panel alone cannot prove equality for an unrestricted family; return scoped empirical evidence or unresolved.

does_not_follow: Finite-tolerance closeness is transitive.
The quotient is automatically finite-dimensional or has a convenient measurable realization.
No richer observer or future test can reveal additional distinctions.
rules.revision_context: Current-10 explicitly identifies the construction with established predictive-state, causal-state, sufficient-statistic and automata ideas; priority is not claimed.

rules.title: Admitted continuations descend to state

citations.section: 2.3, partial intervention descent and observed stochastic continuations

premises.statement: STATE-01 holds for a continuation-closed future family with admissibility included.
For deterministic continuation a, the history extension h -> ha is well defined wherever admitted.
For observed stochastic outcomes retain the record r and use branch h -> har; supply common-support conditions.

conclusion_schema.formula: T_a([h]) = [ha]; for observed stochastic records use T_(a,r)([h]) = [har]
conclusion_schema.consequence: Equivalent histories have equal action domains and equivalent successors; random action outcomes induce a kernel over record-labelled successor states.

solver_requirements.soundness_requirement: Check both domain and value consistency. Do not discard intermediate records before asserting adaptive-policy equivalence.

does_not_follow: One deterministic posterior state is indexed by a random action alone.
Commutation after records are discarded proves commutation of all record-conditioned experiments.
Finite-panel descent has been proved on untested continuations.
rules.revision_context: Current-10 strengthens deterministic descent using continuation closure and separately qualifies stochastic branch semantics.

rules.title: Aczel additive generator for an admitted scalar operation

premises.statement: I is a nondegenerate real interval and op is total I x I -> I.
op is continuous, associative and strictly increasing in each argument, with an identity e0.
Endpoint and domain treatment respect strict monotonicity; saturated limiting endpoints are not silently included.

conclusion_schema.formula: phi(a op b) = phi(a) + phi(b); phi(e0)=0
conclusion_schema.consequence: An increasing homeomorphism phi maps I onto an addition-closed interval; after fixing the identity origin its freedom is positive scale.

solver_requirements.soundness_requirement: Symbolic checks may verify a supplied generator; finite samples cannot establish the unrestricted representation theorem's global premises.

does_not_follow: Boundedness selects artanh, logit, a projective law or a physical metric.
A fitted local rule automatically satisfies the global theorem.
A change of coordinate restores information removed from the state.
rules.revision_context: Current-06 supersedes broad universal-coordinate readings. The identity fixes the origin, leaving positive scale rather than arbitrary translation.

rules.title: Declared UHL composition and rapidity action

premises.statement: x,u,v lie in the open interval (-1,1).
The admitted action is T_u(x)=(x+u)/(1+u*x); if inferred as a physical family, the endpoint-fixing projective hypothesis and parameter calibration must be independently admitted.
All compositions use the same state coordinate and declared action convention.

conclusion_schema.consequence: The declared UHL actions compose by rapidity addition and remain in the open interval.
conclusion_schema.source_translation: Current-06 uses e=(x+1)/2 and lambda=(1+u)/(1-u). Its logit(e) equals 2*artanh(x).

solver_requirements.soundness_requirement: Prove denominators nonzero and domains preserved, then verify exact algebra. Numeric examples are instances only.

does_not_follow: The input u is automatically elapsed time, dose, energy, evidence or resource cost.
Every bounded physical system obeys this family.
One-dimensional scalar nonlinearity establishes intrinsic sectional curvature.
rules.revision_context: The current texts require added projective structure. Source translation is elementary algebra, not an additional empirical claim.

rules.title: Forgetting order requires commuting partial actions

premises.statement: A finite standardized intervention alphabet acts by descended partial maps on the declared predictive state.
Equality of composed partial maps means equal domains and equal outputs on those domains.
Chronological word a1...ak acts as T_ak composed with ... composed with T_a1.

conclusion_schema.formula: rho(w)=rho_bar(counts(w)) for every word iff T_i*T_j=T_j*T_i as partial maps for all i,j
conclusion_schema.consequence: A verified noncommuting pair refutes the count-only action representation; injective coordinate changes cannot erase that difference.
conclusion_schema.additional_gate_for_continuous_amount: Each one-agent family must separately satisfy U_a(s+t)=U_a(s)U_a(t), U_a(0)=I on its admitted range. Counts alone do not provide this gate.

solver_requirements.soundness_requirement: A complete finite table can be checked exhaustively; continuous domains require proof or certified bounds. Testing one unresolved endpoint is insufficient.

does_not_follow: Order dependence proves hidden state dimension exceeds one.
Pairwise commutation calibrates continuous dose or elapsed time.
Function composition ceases to be associative when actions do not commute.
rules.revision_context: Current-10 distinguishes standardized counts, calibrated continuous amounts and scalar descent. Current-06 gives a closed scalar counterexample to 'order implies hidden state'.

rules.title: Weak temporal grammar through second order

premises.statement: A common normed observable/operator space supports U_i(s)=I+s*alpha_i*L_i+s^2*Q_i+O(s^3) uniformly over the declared local window.
Compare a fixed finite word length and fixed multiplicities; w0 is the canonical sorted word.
Use the source's observable pullback convention U_w=U_w1...U_wm and k_ij counting occurrences of j before i for i<j.
A numerical approximation claim additionally has calibrated remainder/error bounds; a qualitative O(s^3) statement supplies no finite-scale confidence guarantee.

conclusion_schema.consequence: Fixed-multiset scalar word responses lie through second order in an affine space with one intercept and at most binomial(r,2) directions.

solver_requirements.soundness_requirement: Retain multiplication order; verify series assumptions separately from fitting inversion-count coefficients.

does_not_follow: A fitted second-order curve proves complete finite-dimensional predictive closure.
No order effect exists when a chosen readout annihilates the leading commutator.
The local expansion holds at arbitrary intervention amplitudes or growing word length.
rules.revision_context: Current-10 calls the nonabelian branch temporal grammar and distinguishes discrete order tests from a calibrated near-identity interpretation.

rules.title: Declare finite resource and regeneration mechanisms

premises.statement: Supply a domain-specific model with typed state/resource variables, units, bounds, rate laws and parameters.
For the cited redox instance declare a finite GSH pool, drain/clearance terms, saturable regeneration and a slower regulated capacity.
Bind calibration sources and parameter uncertainty separately from the mechanism assumptions; declare valid operating ranges.

conclusion_schema.consequence: The declared dynamics can be evaluated for supply/demand balance, capacity limits and consequences of slow capacity changes.

solver_requirements.soundness_requirement: Check dimensions, domain invariance and numerical error. Carry all mechanism and calibration assumptions into derived thresholds.

does_not_follow: Finite boundedness alone forces the cited rate laws, a four-role architecture, hormesis or collapse.
A simulated threshold is a validated biological or clinical threshold.
Resource units from different domains can be interchanged without a calibrated map.
rules.revision_context: The specific redox model is an instantiation. Later programme revisions explicitly separate resource mechanisms, mathematical viability and empirical predictions. This register imports no claimed clinical validation.

rules.title: Finite-horizon and robust viability

premises.statement: Declare a physical realization, admissible dynamics, constraint set K(t), start time t and finite terminal horizon H.
Include resource, environment and timing variables needed for valid state/action closure.
For robustness declare the disturbance family and nonanticipative control information pattern.
Supply existence/regularity hypotheses for continuous dynamics or a complete finite transition relation.

conclusion_schema.formula: V_H(t)={x in K(t): exists admissible trajectory from x staying in K(s) for every s in [t,H]}; V_H(H)=K(H)
conclusion_schema.robust_variant: Require one admissible nonanticipative strategy to preserve constraints against every allowed disturbance.
conclusion_schema.consequence: With matched conventions and the nominal disturbance included in the robust family, the robust viable set is contained in the nominal set.

solver_requirements.soundness_requirement: A grid or simulation is not an exact global certificate without error/coverage guarantees. Separate inner bounds, outer bounds and unresolved states.

does_not_follow: A finite-horizon tube equals an infinite-horizon viability kernel.
A positive local inward margin certifies the entire future.
Failure of one tested policy proves no viable policy exists.
An arbitrary predictive quotient preserves physical viability geometry.
rules.revision_context: Current-05 explicitly distinguishes finite-time, nominal, robust and local statements, and labels Nagumo-Aubin viability as established mathematics.

rules.title: Action can alter later environmental constraints

premises.statement: O_next=F(O,E) and E_next=G(E,O) are admitted structural intervention laws, not merely observational regressions.
The later constraint set is K(E_next).
Two attainable values O and O_prime at the same E satisfy K(G(E,O)) != K(G(E,O_prime)).

conclusion_schema.consequence: The admitted change in organism/system state changes the later constraint set through the environmental channel.

solver_requirements.soundness_requirement: Verify the structural/causal premise and actual set change. A local derivative argument additionally needs the source's regular-boundary and nonredundancy conditions.

does_not_follow: The feedback is beneficial, optimal or anticipatory.
Every adaptation increases resources or robustness.
Self-maintenance requires a universal fixed point rather than cycles or other invariant regimes.
rules.revision_context: Current-05 replaces a universal fixed-point interpretation with coupled invariant-regime reasoning. Causal interpretation remains an explicit premise.

rules.title: Opposing channels imply a bounded-interval positive maximum

premises.statement: A(d) and B(d) are continuous for d>=0 and differentiable at d=0.
A(0)=B(0)=0 and A_prime(0)>B_prime(0).
There is a specified D>0 with A(D)<B(D).

conclusion_schema.consequence: R is positive on some interval (0,delta), has at least one zero after a positive point and before D, and attains a positive maximum on [0,D].
conclusion_schema.readout_extension: A strictly increasing psi preserves ordering and the sign of psi(R)-psi(0), not necessarily the raw sign of psi(R).

solver_requirements.soundness_requirement: Check the actual derivative inequality and negative endpoint. Boundedness or a plotted peak cannot substitute for premises.

does_not_follow: Every bounded system is hormetic.
The maximum is unique or its location/amplitude is fixed.
Every low dose is beneficial for every biological endpoint.
Curve shape identifies the constructive/destructive mechanisms.
rules.revision_context: The current theorem is a sufficient condition, not an iff law. It supersedes broad readings that boundedness alone forces hormesis.

rules.title: Recovery residue adds predictive value

premises.statement: Freeze the reference, chart, dead-band delta, decay beta and feature construction before the evaluation data.
Compute d(t) as chart distance to the declared reference and R_beta(t)=integral_0^t exp(-beta*(t-s))*max(0,d(s)-delta) ds.
Declare the target outcome, horizon, appropriate static/acute-displacement baselines, held-out split, predictive metric and uncertainty rule.
Prevent leakage from future outcomes, moving baselines or post-hoc feature selection.

conclusion_schema.hypothesis: R_beta or declared return features improve held-out prediction beyond the declared static/acute-displacement baseline.
conclusion_schema.mathematical_subclaim: The residue is computable under the frozen metric and regularity conditions; computation does not establish predictive value.

solver_requirements.soundness_requirement: Report scoped comparative evidence and uncertainty; do not convert a finite positive result into universal validity.

does_not_follow: The residue measures physical entropy.
The features are valid biomarkers in an untested domain.
A predictive gain proves that residue-gated actuation improves recovery or is safe.
A synthetic illustration supplies human or biological validation.
rules.revision_context: IDA explicitly separates the computable integral from an unproven effective-model hypothesis. Its read-side and write-side failure conditions are separate.

rules.title: Common-action sufficiency and minimum finite static code

premises.statement: Declare finite states S_plus, finite actions A, success probabilities p_s(a), tolerance alpha and a deterministic code z.
Define acceptable actions A_alpha(s)={a:p_s(a)>=1-alpha}.
For the finite minimum, states are individually feasible; otherwise use an explicit infeasible result.
Any estimated probabilities require a separate simultaneous uncertainty procedure before treating the acceptable-action table as certified.

conclusion_schema.formula: z is sufficient iff every occupied code cell C has intersection_(s in C) A_alpha(s) nonempty
conclusion_schema.minimum: m_star=min{|D|:D subset A and union_(a in D){s:a in A_alpha(s)}=S_plus}; infeasible if no cover exists
conclusion_schema.consequence: A covering action can be assigned to each code cell; minimal conflict hypergraph coloring gives the same finite minimum.

required_inputs: code partition if testing a supplied code
solver_requirements.soundness_requirement: Check complete cell intersections, not just pairwise compatibility. Exact minimality requires exhaustive/optimality certificate, not a heuristic cover alone.

does_not_follow: m_star is the number of states required by a sequential controller.
The observer can measure the abstract code without error or cost.
Full predictive state is necessary for every task.
A common safe abstention action guarantees useful task coverage.
rules.revision_context: Current-11 explicitly calls the optimization classical set cover and separates static selection from recursive closure and executor memory.

rules.title: Binary diagnostic selection bound

premises.statement: There are two equiprobable states with nonempty disjoint acceptable-action sets.
A fixed diagnostic has laws P1 and P2 on the same measurable space.
The diagnostic does not alter the relevant state, action availability or conditional success probabilities.
Use TV(P,Q)=sup_B |P(B)-Q(B)| and distinguish selection error from outcome failure.

conclusion_schema.necessary_condition: A demanded selection-error tolerance delta requires TV(P1,P2)>=1-2*delta.

solver_requirements.soundness_requirement: For an impossibility claim use an upper bound on achievable TV below the required threshold. A noisy estimate or one failed classifier is insufficient.

does_not_follow: Equal-prior Bayes error establishes a uniform per-state guarantee.
Selection-error lower bounds are automatically biological-failure lower bounds.
A tested diagnostic's failure excludes every feasible diagnostic or adaptive policy.
The formula applies unchanged when diagnosis perturbs the relevant risks.
rules.revision_context: Current-11 includes a numerical counterexample separating unacceptable selection from outcome failure, and keeps the one-shot non-disturbing restriction.

rules.title: Witnessed certified-channel invariant

premises.statement: Fix an admitted evidence snapshot, derivation relation and claim-language interpretation.
Initially the channel is empty or supported; admitted evidence remains bound to checked immutable content.
Every factual write uses a sound verifier and the declared introduction rule; the proposer has no bypass or ability to mutate trusted components/inputs.
Failed obligations produce ASK/ABSTAIN or separately verified partial output.
The renderer/parser is semantically sound for the admitted grammar and context, retains qualifications and introduces no additional factual claims.

conclusion_schema.consequence: Every factual proposition in the certified channel is supported relative to the declared evidence snapshot and derivation rules.

solver_requirements.soundness_requirement: A typed JSON object or deterministic renderer alone proves nothing about verifier soundness or bypass prevention. Recompute bindings and admitted operations.

does_not_follow: Supported claims are automatically externally true.
Fluent generation, deterministic code or passing mutation tests proves the entire trusted base sound.
Finite zero-error tests prove population zero error.
The architecture alone guarantees useful coverage.
rules.revision_context: Current-01 makes K0-K6 conditional and records limits of finite mutation tests; no universal truth or formal whole-language verification is claimed.

rules.title: Typed residues organize questions without transferring proofs

premises.statement: Name the local observable, candidate hidden object/projection, residue definition, comparison baseline and held-out failure condition.
Assign the residue its own mathematical/domain type and evidence status.
Treat quotient, coordinate, recovery, addressed and microscopic residues as different objects.

conclusion_schema.consequence: The shared projection-residue schema can organize a new domain-specific hypothesis and test specification.
conclusion_schema.forbidden_promotion: No empirical or formal conclusion transfers solely from another residue sharing this schema.

solver_requirements.soundness_requirement: This rule emits a question/template, never a scientific entailment or validated model.

does_not_follow: An operational negentropy definition independently validates physical entropy export.
The schema itself is a falsifiable universal law.
Success in one scientific domain validates another.
rules.revision_context: IDA explicitly calls schema recurrence a heuristic/filing system and gives separate death conditions. The integrated architecture preserves this distinction.
